title: Why Yuri Gagarin Wasn't the First in Space

mock_data.title: Why Yuri Gagarin Wasn't the First in Space
mock_data.passage:
A New Scientist column by literary historian Vladimir Brljak on the intrepid balloonists who first flew beyond the blue terrestrial sky, challenging the definition of where our world begins to end.

If you were to take off from Earth on a clear day – the kind you want for a launch – you'd see the sky change colours before your eyes. It would shine a bright blue outside your window, becoming deeper as you climbed into the thinning air of the upper atmosphere. At some point, the blue would disappear entirely, and the black of outer space would surround your capsule.

None of this seems controversial today. Everyone knows that the blue day sky is an optical effect caused by sunlight's interaction with the atmosphere. Astronauts have gone up to see for themselves, returning with descriptions of the darkness of space. But this wasn't always the case.

So, who was the first person to experience this? You might instinctively say Yuri Gagarin, as he is often known as the first man in space. But was he?

The first thing we have to consider is where space starts. And that really depends on what you mean by space. The conventional lower limits are those used by the Fédération Aéronautique Internationale – which defines it as 100 kilometres above Earth, a boundary known as the Kármán line – and US governmental and military institutions, which draw the line 50 miles up (around 80 kilometres). Unsurprisingly, these round figures turn out to have messy origins and rationales. The basic idea, however, is that space begins where the atmosphere grows too thin to support conventional airflight, based on aerodynamic or aerostatic lift.

But these definitions are ultimately arbitrary, not concerned with defining and delimiting space as such, but the possibilities of certain technologies and their uses.

Alternatively, there is the dictionary definition. According to the Oxford English Dictionary, space is "the physical universe [...] beyond Earth's atmosphere." Seems simple enough, but our understanding of where our planet's atmosphere ends has changed many times over the centuries. Research now shows that it extends much further than previously assumed. Only around 630,000 kilometres away from our planet are there absolutely no atoms of atmosphere left. No human has reached this space yet. NASA's upcoming Artemis II mission is set to take a crew some 7500 kilometres beyond the moon – a historic feat that will break the long-standing record of Apollo 13, but still over 200,000 kilometres short of space by this definition.

Even so, it seems absurd to argue that the Apollo astronauts never visited space – and I'm not going to do that. But considering the definitions we have, based on either practical or scientific criteria, I would still argue there is something missing. What about a definition based on historical, cultural or intellectual criteria? What is the most meaningful – if not necessarily the most useful or the most accurate – definition of space?

From this perspective, one boundary stands out: the point at which the atmosphere becomes too thin to refract sunlight, and the blue terrestrial sky fades into the black void beyond. To appreciate its significance, we must understand that, for centuries, most Europeans believed space was bright blue. In looking at the day sky, they assumed they were simply looking into space. Unfamiliar with the optical effects produced by the atmosphere, they thought night was merely Earth's own shadow cast as the sun moved behind it, temporarily obscuring this blue universe beyond. Only in the 17th century did scientists begin to conceive of a black universe, but the blue one remained in the popular imagination until the very doorstep of the Space Age, three centuries later.

In historical and cultural terms, a good case can be made that the first astronaut was the first person who flew high enough to see the sky turn black – the first eyewitness to the truth that shattered this ancient bright cosmos.

High-altitude balloonists were already within touching distance in the 1930s. In 1935, the US Explorer II, piloted by Albert Stevens and Orvil Anderson, reached a record 22.1 kilometres. These "pre-astronauts" experienced much of what Gagarin later would. With nearly all of Earth's atmospheric mass beneath them, a pressurised gondola protected them from the lethal environment beyond. On the horizon, they saw, just about, the planet's curvature. But above them – they radioed to the surface – the sky was "very dark indeed, but it can still be called blue, a very dark blue."

But then in 1956, Malcolm Ross and Lee Lewis piloted the Strato-Lab I balloon to 23.2 kilometres, remaining there for several minutes before a malfunctioning valve caused them to descend prematurely. "This was the first time," recorded a US Navy newsletter, "the sky overhead was seen as black." Just a year later, David Simons, piloting the Manhigh II balloon, also reported a "totally dark" sky at a comparable 22.9 kilometres.

Such altitudes had already been attained by rocket-powered aircraft, but the very first person to reach them may not have actually seen the black sky. In 1951, William Bridgeman ascended to 24.2 kilometres in an air-launched rocket plane, the Douglas D-588-2 Skyrocket. But when the press asked him what the sky looked like, Bridgeman, who remained at this peak altitude for mere seconds, couldn't say. "I'm not sure what colour the sky is. I think it's dark, but I'm too damn busy to look out and see."

Only a month before Ross and Lewis took flight, Iven Kincheloe flew the Bell X-2 plane to an unprecedented 38.5 kilometres, but his flight was also very brief, and his view similarly limited. Again, the press asked about seeing a black sky, which was clearly understood by that point as a benchmark for reaching space. Kincheloe explained that he launched directly facing the "very searing white spot" of the sun, "and as a result of this the sky generally around the sun area appeared to be blue-black in colour [...]. However, as we turned around and I had an opportunity to look down-sun, the sky definitely got blacker in colour – toward a kind of a definitely black inky colour."

Kincheloe was also the first to go further than 100,000 feet up – another round figure cited as the boundary of space at the time. Indeed, Kincheloe's biographer called him the "first of the spacemen". But that didn't last long. With the launch of the Sputnik 1 satellite in 1957, and especially with Gagarin's flight in 1961, the idea of what counted as visiting space in the cultural sense moved to reaching Earth's orbit.

But even if the test pilots technically got there first, the balloonists had a better look. David Simons spent more than 24 hours in the stratosphere during the Manhigh II flight. From 30.9 kilometres above the Earth, he observed in detail the alien horizon "where the atmosphere merged with the colorless blackness of space." He was "startled" by the appearance of the stars. With next to no atmosphere left to distort their appearance, they were "untwinkling, living, colorful objects with places of their own in the cosmos and depth in an endless universe." As far as Simons was concerned, he was in space. "Our sealed one-man gondola was really a space cabin, hung from a balloon instead of nestled in the nose of a rocket."

Another spectacular achievement took place in 1960, with Joseph Kittinger's Excelsior III: a widely publicised flight and parachute jump from 31.3 kilometres above the planet. The cameras on Kittinger's gondola were pointed downwards, aiming to capture the death-defying feat of America's "new space hero." Kittinger, however, looked up. "There is a hostile sky above me," he reported. "Void and very black, and very hostile." He returned from his flight humbled by that hostility, saying, "Man will never conquer space. He may live in space, but he will never conquer it."

Of course, not all spaceflights launch in the daytime. But many do, and experiencing the boundary between the familiar blue of our sky and the black of space – however blurry it may be – remains meaningful to astronauts, both military and civilian. In 2021, actor William Shatner took part in a Blue Origin flight, ascending to 107 kilometres. In a post-flight interview, Shatner said, "To see the blue colour go right by, and now you're staring into blackness – that's the thing." The flight crossed the Kármán line, and so by our modern standards he was in space, but the moment at which Shatner subjectively felt in space – "the thing" – was when he saw the sky disappear.

The Kármán line is a number, an intellectual thing. The sky disappearing is a gut thing. Those who first witnessed it couldn't possibly have realised the full historical significance of their experience, with which the old conception of a bright cosmos truly came to an end. Were they the first people in space? In my book, their claim is at least as good as Gagarin's.

mock_data.translation:
Adabiyot tarixchisi Vladimir Brlyak tomonidan yozilgan New Scientist ustuni — ko'k osmon ortidan birinchi bo'lib uchgan jasur sharsimonlar haqida, dunyomiz qaerda boshlanib qaerda tugashini belgilaydigan ta'rifga qarshi chiqish.

Agar siz Yerdan ochiq kunda — uchirish uchun xohlagan kunda — ko'tarilsangiz, osmon rangining ko'z oldingizda o'zgarishini ko'rgan bo'lardingiz. U derazangiz tashqarisida yorqin ko'k rang bilan porlaydi, yuqori atmosferaning siyraklashayotgan havosiga ko'tarilganingizda chuqurroq bo'ladi. Bir nuqtada, ko'k rang butunlay yo'qolib, kosmik bo'shliqning qoraligi kapsulangizni o'rab oladi.

Bugungi kunda bularning hech biri bahsli ko'rinmaydi. Hamma biladi, kunduzgi ko'k osmon quyosh nuri atmosfera bilan o'zaro ta'siri natijasida hosil bo'lgan optik effekt. Astronavtlar o'zlari ko'rish uchun ko'tarilgan va kosmosning qorong'uligi haqidagi tavsiflar bilan qaytgan. Lekin bu har doim ham shunday bo'lmagan.

Xo'sh, buni birinchi bo'lib tajriba qilgan odam kim edi? Siz instinktiv ravishda Yuriy Gagarin desangiz kerak, chunki u kosmosga birinchi uchgan odam sifatida tanilgan. Ammo u shunday edimi?

Biz ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak bo'lgan birinchi narsa — kosmos qaerdan boshlanishi. Va bu haqiqatan ham kosmos deganda nimani nazarda tutishingizga bog'liq. An'anaviy pastki chegaralar Fédération Aéronautique Internationale tomonidan qo'llaniladigan chegaralar — u Yerdan 100 kilometr balandlikni kosmos deb belgilaydi, bu chegara Karman chizig'i deb ataladi — va AQSh hukumat va harbiy muassasalari chegarani 50 mil yuqorida (taxminan 80 kilometr) chizadi. Kutilganidek, bu yumaloq raqamlar chalkash kelib chiqish va asoslarga ega ekanligi ma'lum bo'ladi. Asosiy g'oya shuki, kosmos atmosferaning aerodinamik yoki aerostatik ko'tarish asosida an'anaviy havo parvozini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun juda yupqa bo'lgan joyidan boshlanadi.

Ammo bu ta'riflar oxir-oqibat ixtiyoriy bo'lib, kosmosni aniqlash va chegaralash bilan emas, balki ma'lum texnologiyalarning imkoniyatlari va ulardan foydalanish bilan bog'liq.

Shu bilan birga, lug'at ta'rifi ham bor. Oxford English Dictionaryga ko'ra, kosmos "Yer atmosferasidan tashqaridagi [...] fizik koinot." Yetarlicha oddiy ko'rinadi, ammo sayyoramiz atmosferasi qaerda tugashi haqidagi tushunchamiz asrlar davomida ko'p marta o'zgagan. Tadqiqotlar endi u avval taxmin qilinganidan ancha uzoqqa cho'zilganini ko'rsatmoqda. Faqat sayyoramizdan taxminan 630 000 kilometr uzoqlikda atmosferaning mutlaqo hech qanday atomlari qolmaydi. Hech bir inson hali bu kosmosga yetib bormagan. NASAning kelgusi Artemis II missiyasi ekipajni Oydan taxminan 7500 kilometr nariroqqa olib borishi kerak — Apollo 13 ning uzoq vaqtlik rekordini sindiradigan tarixiy yutuq, ammo bu ta'rif bo'yicha hali ham kosmosdan 200 000 kilometrdan ko'proq yetishmaydi.

Shunga qaramay, Apollo astronavtlari hech qachon kosmosga tashrif buyurmagan deb da'vo qilish befoyda ko'rinadi — va men buni qilmoqchi emasman. Ammo bizda mavjud ta'riflarni hisobga olsak, amaliy yoki ilmiy mezonlardan kelib chiqsak, men hali ham biror narsa yetishmayotganini aytgan bo'lardim. Tarixiy, madaniy yoki intellektual mezonlarga asoslangan ta'rif haqida nima deyish mumkin? Eng mazmunli — agar eng foydali yoki eng aniq bo'lmasa ham — kosmos ta'rifi nima?

Bu nuqtai nazardan, bitta chegara ajralib turadi: atmosfera quyosh nurini sindirish uchun juda yupqa bo'ladigan va ko'k yerga tegishli osmon narigi tomonning qora bo'shlig'iga yo'qoladigan nuqta. Uning ahamiyatini tushunish uchun biz asrlar davomida ko'pchilik yevropa aholisi kosmos yorqin ko'k rangda deb ishonganini bilishimiz kerak. Kunduzgi osmonga qarab, ular shunchaki kosmosga qarayotgan deb o'ylashgan. Atmosfera hosil qiladigan optik effektlarni bilmagan holda, ular tunni faqat quyosh orqasiga o'tganda Yerning o'z soyasi deb hisoblashgan, bu ko'k koinotni vaqtincha to'sib qo'ygan. Faqat 17-asrda olimlar qora koinotni tasavvur qila boshladilar, ammo ko'k koinot xalq tasavvurida Kosmik Asrning ostonasigacha, uch asr keyin ham davom etdi.

Tarixiy va madaniy jihatdan, birinchi astronavt osmonning qorayib ketishini ko'rish uchun yetarlicha balandga uchgan birinchi odam — bu qadimiy yorqin kosmosni parchalagan haqiqatning birinchi guvohidir deb yaxshi asos yaratish mumkin.

Baland parvozli sharsimonlar 1930-yillardayoq yaqin masofada edilar. 1935-yilda Albert Stivens va Orvil Anderson boshchiligidagi AQSh Explorer II 22,1 kilometr rekordiga yetdi. Bu "oldindan astronavtlar" Gagarinning keyinchalik boshdan kechiradigan ko'p narsalarni boshdan kechirdilar. Yer atmosfera massasining deyarli hammasi ostida bo'lgan holda, bosimli gondola ularni tashqaridagi halokatli muhitdan himoya qildi. Ufqda ular sayyoraning egri chizig'ini zo'rg'a ko'rdilar. Lekin ularning tepasida — ular yerga radio orqali xabar berdilar — osmon "haqiqatan ham juda qorong'u, lekin hali ham ko'k deb aytish mumkin, juda qorong'u ko'k."

Ammo 1956-yilda Malkolm Ross va Li Lyuis Strato-Lab I sharini 23,2 kilometrga boshqarib, noto'g'ri ishlaydigan klapan ularni erta tushishga majbur qilgunga qadar bir necha daqiqa u yerda qoldilar. "Bu birinchi marta edi," deb yozdi AQSh Harbiy-dengiz kuchlari axborotnomasi, "yuqoridagi osmon qora ko'rindi." Atigi bir yil o'tib, Manhigh II sharini boshqargan Devid Simons ham shunga o'xshash 22,9 kilometrda "butunlay qorong'u" osmonni xabar qildi.

Bunday balandliklar raketali samolyotlar tomonidan allaqachon erishilgan edi, ammo ularga birinchi bo'lib yetib borgan odam qora osmonni aslida ko'rmagan bo'lishi mumkin. 1951-yilda Uilyam Brijmen havoda uchirilgan raketa samolyoti Douglas D-588-2 Skyrocket bilan 24,2 kilometrga ko'tarildi. Ammo matbuot undan osmon qanday ko'rinishini so'raganida, cho'qqi balandligida atigi bir necha soniya qolgan Brijmen javob bera olmadi. "Osmon qanday rangda ekaniga ishonchim komil emas. Qorong'u deb o'ylayman, lekin men tashqariga qarab ko'rish uchun juda band edim."

Ross va Lyuisning parvozidan atigi bir oy oldin, Ayven Kincheloe Bell X-2 samolyotini misli ko'rilmagan 38,5 kilometrga uchirib, ammo uning parvozi ham juda qisqa edi va ko'rinishi xuddi shunday cheklangan edi. Yana matbuot qora osmonni ko'rish haqida so'radi, bu o'sha paytga kelib kosmosga yetish uchun mezon sifatida aniq tushunildi. Kincheloe u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri quyoshning "juda kuydiradigan oq dog'i"ga qarab uchirilganini tushuntirdi, "va buning natijasida quyosh atrofidagi osmon ko'k-qora rangda ko'rindi [...]. Biroq, biz aylanib, men quyoshdan nariroq qarash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lganimda, osmon aniq qorayroq bo'ldi — aniq qora siyoh rangga tomon."

Kincheloe shuningdek, 100 000 futdan yuqoriga birinchi bo'lib ko'tarilgan — bu ham o'sha paytda kosmos chegarasi sifatida keltirilgan yana bir yumaloq raqam. Haqiqatan ham, Kincheloening biografchi uni "kosmoschilarning birinchisi" deb atagan. Ammo bu uzoq davom etmadi. 1957-yilda Sputnik 1 sun'iy yo'ldoshining uchirishi va ayniqsa 1961-yilda Gagarin parvozi bilan, madaniy ma'noda kosmosga tashrif buyurish sifatida nimani hisoblash g'oyasi Yer orbitasiga yetishga ko'chdi.

Ammo sinov uchuvchilari texnik jihatdan birinchi bo'lib yetib borgan bo'lsalar ham, sharsimonlar yaxshiroq ko'rishdi. Devid Simons Manhigh II parvozi davomida stratosferada 24 soatdan ortiq vaqt o'tkazdi. Yerdan 30,9 kilometr balandlikdan u "atmosfera kosmosning rangsiz qoraligi bilan qo'shilgan" begona ufqni batafsil kuzatdi. U yulduzlarning paydo bo'lishidan "hayratga tushdi". Ularning ko'rinishini buzish uchun deyarli hech qanday atmosfera qolmaganligi sababli, ular "miltillamas, jonli, rangli ob'ektlar bo'lib, cheksiz koinotda o'z o'rinlari va chuqurligi bor edi." Simonsning fikricha, u kosmosda edi. "Bizning muhrlab yopilgan bir kishilik gondolamiz raketaning burniga joylashgan o'rniga shardan osilgan kosmik kabina edi."

Yana bir ajoyib yutuq 1960-yilda Jozef Kittingerning Excelsior III missiyasi bilan amalga oshdi: sayyoradan 31,3 kilometr balandlikdan keng e'lon qilingan parvoz va parashyut sakrash. Kittingerning gondolasidagi kameralar Amerikaning "yangi kosmik qahramoni"ning o'limga qarshi yutuqini suratga olish uchun pastga qaratilgan edi. Kittinger esa yuqoriga qaradi. "Mening tepamda dushman osmon bor," deb xabar berdi u. "Bo'sh va juda qora, va juda dushman." U o'sha dushmanligi oldida kamtar bo'lib parvozdan qaytdi va shunday dedi: "Inson hech qachon kosmosni zabt eta olmaydi. U kosmosda yashashi mumkin, lekin hech qachon zabt eta olmaydi."

Albatta, barcha kosmik parvozlar kunduzgi vaqtda uchirish boshlamaydi. Ammo ko'plari shunday qiladi va bizning osmonimizdagi tanish ko'k rang va kosmosning qoraligi o'rtasidagi chegarani his qilish — u qanchalik xiralashgan bo'lmasin — harbiy va fuqaro astronavtlar uchun mazmunli bo'lib qoladi. 2021-yilda aktyor Uilyam Shatner Blue Origin parvozida qatnashib, 107 kilometrga ko'tarildi. Parvozdan keyingi intervyuda Shatner shunday dedi: "Ko'k rangning o'tib ketishini ko'rish va endi qoralikka tikilib qolish — bu asl narsa." Parvoz Karman chizig'ini kesib o'tdi va zamonaviy standartlarimiz bo'yicha u kosmosda edi, ammo Shatner subyektiv ravishda kosmosda ekanligini his qilgan lahza — "asl narsa" — u osmonning yo'qolishini ko'rganida edi.

Karman chizig'i raqam, intellektual narsa. Osmonning yo'qolishi ichki his. Buni birinchi bo'lib ko'rganlar o'z tajribalarining to'liq tarixiy ahamiyatini — u bilan birga yorqin kosmos haqidagi qadimiy tushuncha haqiqatan ham tugagan — tushunishlari mumkin bo'lmagan. Ular kosmosga birinchi bo'lib borgan odamlar edimi? Mening kitobimda, ularning da'vosi kamida Gagarinniki kabi kuchli.

Muqobil nuqtai nazarni lug'at ta'riflaridan olish mumkin. Misol uchun, Oxford English Dictionary kosmosni "Yer atmosferasidan tashqaridagi [...] jismoniy koinot" deb ta'riflaydi. Garchi oddiy tuyulsa-da, atmosferaning tashqi chegaralari haqidagi tushunchamiz vaqt o'tishi bilan sezilarli darajada o'zgardi. Hozirgi tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, atmosfera avvalgi hisob-kitoblardan ancha uzoqqa cho'ziladi, uning eng tashqi qoldiqlari Yer yuzidan taxminan 630 000 kilometrgacha aniqlanishi mumkin. Hozirgacha hech bir inson bu qadar uzoqqa bormagan. NASAning yaqinlashib kelayotgan Artemis II missiyasi, ekipajni Oydan taxminan 7500 kilometr uzoqlikka olib borishga tayyorlanmoqda, bu Apollo 13 tomonidan o'rnatilgan uzoq yillik rekorddan oshib, tarixiy voqea bo'ladi. Biroq, u atmosfera zarralarining mavjudligi bilan belgilangan kosmosga yetib borish uchun hali ham 200 000 kilometrdan ortiq masofaga yetmaydi.

Shunga qaramay, Apollo astronavtlari hech qachon kosmosga sayohat qilmagan deb bahslashish bema'nilik bo'lib tuyuladi va men buni qilish niyatida emasman. Shunga qaramay, mavjud ta'riflarni, ham amaliy, ham ilmiy jihatdan hisobga olgan holda, muhim element yo'q deb hisoblayman. Tarixiy, madaniy yoki hatto intellektual mulohazalarga asoslangan ta'rif haqida nima deyish mumkin? Kosmosning *eng* mazmunli ta'rifi nima, agar u eng pragmatik foydali yoki ilmiy jihatdan aniq bo'lmasa ham?

Shu nuqtai nazardan, muayyan chegara katta ahamiyatga ega bo'ladi: atmosfera quyosh nurini sindirishni to'xtatadigan balandlik va yer yuzining tanish ko'k rangi tashqaridagi qora qorong'ulikka yo'l beradi. Uning ahamiyatini to'liq anglash uchun shuni tan olish kerakki, asrlar davomida ko'plab yevropaliklar kosmos aslida yorqin ko'k rangda, deb hisoblashgan. Ular kunduzgi osmonni kosmosning o'ziga bevosita qarash deb bilishgan. Atmosfera tomonidan yaratilgan optik effektlar bilan tanish bo'lmagan holda, ular tun shunchaki Quyosh orqasida harakatlanayotganda Yer soyasining bu ko'k olamni to'sib qo'yishi natijasidir, deb nazariya qilishdi. Faqatgina XVII asrda olimlar qora olamni tasavvur qila boshladilar, ammo yorqin ko'k koinot g'oyasi kosmik davrda, uch asr o'tib, ommaviy tasavvurda saqlanib qoldi.

Shuning uchun, tarixiy va madaniy nuqtai nazardan, birinchi haqiqiy "astronavt" osmon qora rangga aylanishini ko'rish uchun yetarlicha yuqoriga ko'tarilgan birinchi shaxs bo'lganligi haqida jiddiy bahs qilish mumkin - yorqin koinot haqidagi uzoq yillik e'tiqodni buzgan haqiqatga birinchi guvoh.

Balandlikdagi havo sharlarida uchuvchilar 1930-yillarda allaqachon bu tajribaga yaqinlashgan edilar. 1935-yilda Albert Stevens va Orvil Anderson tomonidan boshqarilgan AQSh Explorer II 22,1 kilometr rekord balandlikka erishdi. Bu "pre-astronavtlar" Gagarin keyinchalik duch keladigan ko'plab sharoitlarni boshdan kechirdilar. Bosimli gondolaga o'ralgan holda, ular tashqaridagi o'lik muhitdan himoyalangan, Yer atmosferasining katta qismi ularning ostida edi. Ular gorizontda sayyoraning egriligini aniqlay oldilar. Biroq, ular radio orqali yuqoridagi osmon "juda qorong'i, lekin uni hali ham ko'k, juda to'q ko'k deb atash mumkin" deb xabar berishdi.

Biroq, 1956-yilda Malcolm Ross va Li Lyuis Strato-Lab I shari bilan 23,2 kilometr balandlikka ko'tarilib, valf nosozligi erta tushishga majbur qilgunga qadar bir necha daqiqa davomida u yerda qolishdi. AQSh dengiz floti axborot byulleteniga ko'ra, "Bu osmon tepada qora rangda ko'rilgan birinchi holat edi." Bir yil o'tgach, Devid Simons Manhigh II shari parvozi paytida ham 22,9 kilometr balandlikda "butunlay qorong'i" osmon haqida xabar berdi.

Bunday balandliklarga raketali samolyotlar ham erishgan bo'lsa-da, ularga birinchi bo'lib yetib borgan odam qora osmonni kuzatmagan bo'lishi mumkin. 1951-yilda Uilyam Bridjman havodan uchirilgan raketa samolyoti Douglas D-588-2 Skyrocketda 24,2 kilometrgacha ko'tarildi. Biroq, matbuot tomonidan osmonning ko'rinishi haqida so'ralganda, eng yuqori balandlikda bir necha soniya qolgan Bridjman aniq javob bera olmadi. "Osmonning rangi qanday ekanligiga amin emasman. O'ylaymanki, u qorong'i, lekin tashqariga qarashga juda bandman", dedi u.

Ross va Lyuisning parvozidan bir oy oldin Iven Kinchelo Bell X-2 samolyotini 38,5 kilometr balandlikka ko'tardi. Biroq, uning parvozi ham qisqa, ko'rinishi ham cheklangan edi. Yana bir bor, matbuot qora osmon haqida so'radi, o'sha paytga kelib kosmosga yetib borishning asosiy ko'rsatkichi sifatida aniq tushunilgan edi. Kinchelo, u to'g'ridan-to'g'ri quyoshning "juda yorqin oq dog'i" ga qarab uchirilganini tushuntirdi, "va buning natijasida quyosh atrofidagi osmon umuman ko'k-qora rangda edi [...]. Biroq, biz o'girilib, quyoshga pastdan qarash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lganimizda, osmon albatta qora rangga aylandi - aniq siyoh qora rangga qarab".

Kinchelo, shuningdek, 100 000 futdan oshgan birinchi odam edi - o'sha paytda kosmos chegarasi sifatida keltirilgan yana bir yumaloq raqam. Haqiqatan ham, Kincheloning tarjimai holi muallifi uni "kosmonavtlarning birinchisi" deb atadi. Biroq, bu farq qisqa umr ko'rdi. 1957-yilda Sputnik 1 uchirilishi bilan va ayniqsa, 1961-yilda Gagarinning parvozi bilan "kosmosga tashrif" nimani tashkil etishi haqidagi madaniy tushuncha Yer orbitasiga yetib borishga o'zgardi.

Biroq, sinovchi uchuvchilar texnik jihatdan bu balandliklarga birinchi bo'lib erishgan bo'lsalar ham, havo sharlarida uchuvchilar shubhasiz yanada qiziqarli tomosha tajribasiga ega edilar. Devid Simons Manhigh II parvozi paytida stratosferada 24 soatdan ortiq vaqt o'tkazdi. Yer yuzidan 30,9 kilometr balandlikda u "atmosfera kosmosning rangsiz qoraligi bilan qo'shilib ketgan" begona gorizontni sinchkovlik bilan kuzatdi. U yulduzlarning ko'rinishidan "hayratga tushdi". Minimal atmosfera buzilishi bilan ular "miltillamagan, tirik, rang-barang ob'ektlar bo'lib, koinotda o'z o'rinlariga va cheksiz olamda chuqurlikka ega edilar". Simons uchun u kosmosda edi. "Bizning muhrlangan bir kishilik gondolamiz haqiqatan ham kosmik kabina edi, raketaning buruniga o'rnashish o'rniga shar bilan osilgan edi".

Yana bir ajoyib yutuq 1960-yilda Jozef Kittingerning Excelsior III bilan sodir bo'ldi: sayyora yuzidan 31,3 kilometr balandlikdan yuqori darajada e'lon qilingan parvoz va parashyutda sakrash. Kittingerning gondolasidagi kameralar pastga qaratilgan bo'lib, Amerikaning "yangi kosmik qahramoni"ning o'limga olib keladigan jasoratini suratga olishga mo'ljallangan edi. Biroq, Kittinger yuqoriga qaradi. "Mening tepamda dushman osmon bor", deb xabar berdi u. "Bo'sh va juda qora va juda dushman." Qaytganidan so'ng, u bu dushmanlik qarshisida kamtarlik hissini bildirdi va "Inson hech qachon kosmosni zabt eta olmaydi. U kosmosda yashashi mumkin, lekin uni hech qachon zabt eta olmaydi", dedi.

Albatta, barcha kosmik parvozlar kunduzgi soatlarda uchirilmaydi. Biroq, ularning ko'pchiligi shunday va bizning osmonimizning tanish ko'kligi va kosmosning qoraligi o'rtasidagi chegarani kesib o'tish tajribasi - qanchalik aniq bo'lmasin - astronavtlar, ham harbiy, ham fuqarolik uchun juda mazmunli bo'lib qolmoqda. 2021-yilda aktyor Uilyam Shatner Blue Origin parvozida ishtirok etib, 107 kilometrgacha ko'tarildi. Parvozdan keyingi intervyusida Shatner shunday dedi: "Ko'k rangning o'tib ketayotganini ko'rish va endi siz qoralikka tikilib qoldingiz - bu narsa". Parvoz Kármán chizig'idan o'tib, kosmosga yetib borishning zamonaviy standartlariga javob bergan bo'lsa-da, Shatner sub'ektiv ravishda o'zini "kosmosda" his qilgan payt - "narsa" - aynan osmon yo'qolgan payt edi.

Kármán chizig'i shunchaki raqam, mavhum tushunchadir. Osmonning yo'qolishi esa, aksincha, sezgi bilan his qilinadigan tajribadir. Bu hodisaga birinchi bo'lib guvoh bo'lganlar, yorqin koinotning qadimiy tushunchasiga samarali ravishda chek qo'ygan tajribalarining to'liq tarixiy ahamiyatini tushunishlari qiyin edi. Ular kosmosdagi birinchi odamlar edimi? Mening fikrimcha, ularning da'vosi Gagarinning da'vosi kabi kamida asosli. Kosmik sayohat va bizning olamdagi o'rnimiz haqidagi tushuncha ushbu paradigma o'zgarishlariga bog'liq.
